verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for calendar and scheduling products, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents Google Calendar as a hosted service reached through a REST API and client libraries. Nothing shows source code, a container image, or an open-source license, and the user who switched to self-hosted Radicale is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full scheduling engine from source or a container image under an open-source license
